title: Midka la doortay ee Articulate
intro: Hooska buur ay ereyada rabbaaniga ah ka soo degeen, iimaankii dadku wuxuu ku hoos dhacay dhalaalka dahabka. Hal naf, oo hibo u leh aftahannimada, ayaa u istaagtay sidii taageero hawlgal weyn, haddana waxay la kulantay daqiiqad tijaabo qoto dheer ah. Markii rasuulkii la doortay uu u kacay ballan barakeysan, qofkan ayaa ka haray, isagoo baryaya quruun aan nasasho lahayn. Waa kuma naftan adag oo codkeedu ka soo horjeedo sanam caabudidda?
clues: Waxaa Alle ii doortay inaan noqdo nebi, inkastoo sheekadayda inta badan la sheego iyadoo lala socdo mid kale.
Waxaa la ii diray taliye kaligii talis ah, laakiin doorkaygu wuxuu ahaa inaan taageero, ee ma ahayn inaan hoggaamiyo.
Waxaan hibo u lahaa aftahannimada, ereyadayduna waxay ahaayeen kuwo qalbiyada jilcinaya.
Markii saaxiibkay ballan barakeysan u baxay, waxaa la ii daayay inaan hago dad aan nasasho lahayn.
Dulqaad la'aantooda awgeed, waxay sawir ka sameeyeen qurxintooda, waxaanan ka baryay inay daacad u ahaadaan Alle.
Saaxiibkay ayaa soo laabtay oo i qabtay, laakiin waxaan u sharraxay in dadku ay iga adkaadeen oo ay ku dhawaadeen inay i dilaan; kama aanan mid ahayn kuwa daalimiinta ah.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
